snippet.title: Gem Quest: Rush - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The first trailer for the upcoming Time-Attack Collectathon game 'Gem Quest: Rush', announcing the release date and providing a first look at the gameplay.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/4760420/Gem_Quest_Rush/

An old wizard has fallen on hard times and can't afford their rent. RUSH into the underground dungeon in search of valuable hidden treasures before you get kicked to the streets! LOCATE chests, AVOID traps, PLAN an optimal route, and COLLECT all the gems as quickly as you can.


Gem Quest: Rush, releasing 17th Of September 2026.
Independently Developed and Published by Poifer.
